{{Quote|And you'd better remember that there are nasty creatures lurking in the purple botanical paradise that's supposed to be Garqi.|Jaina Solo, to her brother Jacen|<ref name="DT2" />}}
'''Garqi''' was an [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] and the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Tadrin sector/Legends|Tadrin sector]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Natural elements in Garqi's crust gave the native plant life a purple coloration. From space, the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] appeared a beautiful, hypnotic violet color. It was the source of the beans used to make [[Caf/Legends|caf]].

==History==
[[File:Vlassy_nature_preserve.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Vlassy Nature Preserve on Garqi]]

===Clone Wars===
Garqi was aligned by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TEA" />

During the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]] in the late stages of the war, the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Battle of Garqi (Clone Wars)|battled]] [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic forces]] on Garqi.<ref name="TEA" /> In response, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] sent an army under the [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Traavis]]. A squad of [[Clone commando/Legends|Clone commandos]], [[Aiwha Squad]], was involved in the fightings on Garqi. During the battle, Republic artillery accidentally bombed a Garqian farmhouse and General Traavis deployed clone commandos to search for survivors and to bring them to a refugee camp. Aiwha Squad notably escorted the young child [[Evan]] to the Republic encampment on the planet.<ref name="Orders" /> Near the end of the Clone Wars, the Republic finally defeated the Separatists on Garqi.<ref name="DAJ">{{InsiderCite|87|Order 66: Destroy All Jedi}}</ref> General Traavis was lost during the conflict when Aiwha Squad murdered him due to the execution of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]].<ref name="Orders" />

===Galactic Civil War===
Prior to the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] established a military garrison on the planet. Despite the destruction of the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]], the Empire still held on to Garqi, keeping its inhabitants in check through the [[Garqi Eagles|Garqi Eagle Squadron]]. However, the population continued to resist the Empire, with much of the movement originating from the [[Garqi Agricultural University]], located near the planetary capital of [[Pesktda]].<ref name="MC" />

After [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] left the [[Corellian Security Force]], he came to Garqi on the run from the Empire. The University students knew him through his droid, [[Whistler]]. Working undercover as an aide to [[Imperial Prefect/Legends|Imperial Prefect]] [[Mosh Barris/Legends|Mosh Barris]], Corran helped many political prisoners [[Great Evacuation|escape]] from Garqi. Two of the prisoners were [[Dynba Tesc]] and the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] trader [[Lai Nootka]].<ref name="MC" />

In the following years, the Garqi system was part of the [[Pentastar Alignment]] and later fell under control of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]].<ref name="TEA" /> After the Empire was driven from Garqi, the planet joined the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="GATORW" />

===Yuuzhan Vong War===
{{Quote|Did you expect we did not know of the sightings of Yuuzhan Vong on Garqi?|Traest Kre'fey to Borsk Fey'lya in the early stages of the Yuuzhan Vong War|<ref name="DT1">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide I: Onslaught]]''</ref>}}
During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], Garqi was [[Invasion of Garqi|conquered]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. The New Republic was forced to abandon the population, who went [[Resistance (Garqi)|underground]], resisting the alien invaders. It was later discovered that the Yuuzhan Vong were using the planet as a training ground for their [[Chazrach]] slaves. A [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-led force [[Battle of Garqi|scouted]] the planet in a battle in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] and succeeded in divining a terrible flaw in Yuuzhan Vong crab-shell armor as it came into contact with [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[bafforr tree]] pollen from the [[Pesktda Xenobotanical Garden|botanical gardens]] in Pesktda. The gardens were destroyed to conceal this information, but the Yuuzhan Vong discovered the effects of the pollen, and destroyed [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]] as a result.<ref name="DT2" />

===Later history===
Garqi would remain under the control of the Yuuzhan Vong for the remainder of the war, until the galaxy was liberated in [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]]. After this time, the region was absorbed into the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]], deep in its space during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] and, by [[137 ABY]], remaining in the possession of the [[Fel Empire]] and subsequent [[Empire-in-exile]].<ref name="TEA" />
